headline: EMC +100.00% open-gap and PLE 6.6σ volume spike dominate an unusually active PROP/CONS morning tape

CONMAT shows two-way stress: GEL posts a -20.00% gap but +25.00% intraday reversal, while DCON gaps up -6.25% to close -11.76% intraday. Filings cluster around capital actions (STPI, TKN, ALLY, WHART) with two SET clarification flags (AKS high, OKJ high) still relevant and TTCL rehab progress pending.
